as_of_content:
The '''Quintessons''' - Judgement, Rage, Wisdom, Laughter, and Death -  are the creators of the Transformers/Cybertronian race, but also antagonize Bots of all factions due to their egotist and violent purposes in the main [[Story]].

They are also the creators of the [[Bots]] known as the [[Sharkticon|Sharkticons]].

</gallery>
